Arlington County premises

Every business place from Overture Maps in the county (7,146), drawn by curtilage 0.9.1 with default settings, November 2026. One outline per building; click one for the businesses on it, or search.

The base map loads OpenStreetMap or USGS tiles for the area on screen; with none, the page loads nothing more.

    The grey circle is left out: a held-out benchmark site is there, and its results stay unseen. A site is one building: pins on the same building (offices in a tower) are one site. Overlaps count from 10 m². Nearby shared parking counts as inside by the default definition, so some shared ground is expected; another business's building never is (garages and canopies aside).
